sentence: In ambitious mitigation pathways, CDR serves three functions: (i) further reducing net CO2 or GHG emissions in the near term; (ii) counterbalancing residual emissions from hard-to-transition sectors such as transport, industry or agriculture to help reach net zero in the mid term; and (iii) achieving and sustaining net-negative emissions in the long term [1].
Its role grows over time, from a modest contribution today to several gigatons by mid-century and potentially net-negative emissions later in the century [1].
